describe:
Fixed or Hourly, in the purple colours.
Works out:
- eff is fee divided by hours when hours is more than 0, otherwise 0.
Remembers while you use it: fee, starting at 0; hours, starting at 10; rate, starting at 20.
Shows:
- a box to fill in fee, labelled "Fixed fee".
- a box to fill in rate, labelled "My hourly rate".
- text: "Estimated hours", hours.
- a slider for hours from 1 to 200.
- if fee is more than 0:
  - a card with a big number eff times 100 rounded divided by 100, labelled "per hour on the fixed fee", with a ring toward 0 when there is one.
  - a big number: rate times hours rounded, labelled "hourly total".
  - a big number: fee minus rate times hours rounded, labelled "extra with fixed fee" when fee is at least rate times hours, otherwise "short with fixed fee".
  - if fee is at least rate times hours:
    - text: "Take the fixed fee, if the hours hold.".
  - otherwise:
    - text: "Bill hourly, the fixed fee is too low.".
- otherwise:
  - text: "Type the fee offered.".
needs: effective hourly rate of the fixed fee

describe:
College Fund, in the red colours.
Works out:
- future is cost times the pow of 1 plus rise divided by 100.
- r is ret divided by 1200.
- n is years times 12.
- monthly is future divided by n when r is 0, otherwise future times r divided by the result of the pow of 1 plus r minus 1.
Remembers while you use it: cost, starting at 1500000; years, starting at 12; rise, starting at 8; ret, starting at 10.
Shows:
- a box to fill in cost, labelled "Cost today".
- text: "Years to go", years.

- text: "Fees rise", rise, "% a year".
- a slider for rise from 0 to 20.
- text: "Savings earn", ret, "% a year".
- a slider for ret from 0 to 20.
- a card with a big number monthly rounded, labelled "to save each month", with a ring toward 0 when there is one.
- text: "The course will cost about", future rounded, "when he starts.".
needs: future cost and monthly saving needed
